```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 block
title "Certificate renewal automation"

block scheduler "Scheduler"
block renewaljob "Renewal Job"
block caclient "CA Client"
block ca "Certificate Authority"
block deployagent "Deploy Agent"
block service "Service"

scheduler -> renewaljob "timer"
renewaljob -> caclient "obtain cert"
caclient -> ca "request cert"
renewaljob -> deployagent "new cert"
deployagent -> service "restart"
```

Notes on the figure:

- Six blocks, one per component named in the prompt: `scheduler`, `renewaljob`, `caclient`, `ca`, `deployagent`, `service`.
- Exactly the five connections the description states, each carrying a short label rather than restating the full sentence from the prompt (per the "keep labels short" guidance).
- No `class` declarations were added — every block plays a distinct role already named by its label, so there's no shared meaning across nodes worth calling out separately.
- This is the `block` genre, one of the portable three, so it should render on any `figdown 0.1` engine without any experimental-construct risk.

I don't have `node <this-skill-dir>/build-svg.js` available in this environment to run the validate step, so I can't produce the paired `.svg` or confirm a clean build here — flagging that rather than claiming a pass I haven't actually run.
